name: Chen Ruilang
activity: Travelling along a mountain road with two friends during the Mid-Autumn Festival, listening to music with the windows open and a full moon outside. I felt happy and free, even though the journey was chaotic.

name: Chen Ruilang
activity: Taking a jumping photo with two friends in an old village. We counted down together and tried to jump at the same time, laughing at how the picture turned out. It was a simple, joyful moment.

name: Chen Ruilang
activity: Making a personalised birthday gift for a friend: a small electronic device with our photos, a pixel birthday cake and music. Seeing the cake light up and hearing the music play felt rewarding.

name: Chen Ruilang
activity: Working on my Electron Cloud typeface for Creative Coding and seeing the particles move around the letters and respond to the mouse. I was excited to see an abstract idea become something I could interact with.

name: Chen Ruilang
activity: Working on my Chinese chess coach and reaching the point where I could use an interactive board inside a conversation. It was satisfying to bring my interests in chess and AI together.

name: Chen Ruilang
activity: Starting a diary based on everyday recordings, including conversations with friends. I felt hopeful about keeping the small moments I usually forget and being able to revisit those conversations years later.

name: Chen Ruilang
activity: Looking at my grades and planning how to improve them for future study opportunities. I felt worried about whether I could reach my goals while keeping up with my projects and other commitments.

name: Chen Ruilang
activity: Trying to rent a car for a trip with friends, only to run into unavailable cars, driving-experience requirements and app-verification problems. I felt frustrated because even getting the trip started had become complicated.

name: Chen Ruilang
activity: Walking in the wrong direction in an old village with two friends on a very hot day, then having to turn back. I was tired and annoyed, even though we kept joking with each other.

name: Chen Ruilang
activity: Seeing an 'Infinite loop detected' error stop my creative coding sketch while I was working on it. I felt stuck and disappointed because I had an idea I wanted to express, but the code was not working.
